context.transcript:
Making headlines today is the City Art Museum.
After two months of renovations, the museum is finally reopening to the public.
To celebrate, they are presenting a temporary exhibition titled Art of Today.
This show will feature artworks by some of the most acclaimed contemporary Canadian artists, including Su Min Lee, recipient of the Canadian Artist of the Year Award.
This Saturday, the mayor will give an address at the opening ceremony.
Visit the City Art Museum's website for more details.
context.transcript_translation:
今天登上头条的是城市艺术博物馆。
经过两个月的翻修，该博物馆终于向公众重新开放了。
为庆祝这一消息，他们正在举办一个名为“今日艺术”的临时展览。
本次展出将展示一些最著名的当代加拿大艺术家（包括获得年度加拿大艺术家奖的 Su Min Lee）的作品。
本周六，市长将在开幕式上发表讲话。
请访问城市艺术博物馆的网站了解更多详情。
